description: This file defines the ProcessInfo class and related classes for process management, including process memory stats, process iteration, and process hierarchy within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a process, including memory stats, priority, policy, and methods to manipulate or retrieve process details.

classes.name: ProcessCurrent
classes.description: Derived class providing information and operations specific to the current process.

classes.name: ProcessTree
classes.description: Represents a hierarchy of processes, allowing to check containment and retrieve process IDs.

classes.name: Memory
classes.description: Nested class within ProcessInfo for managing process memory statistics.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: Nested class within ProcessInfo for iterating over processes based on different criteria.

methods.name: ProcessInfo()
methods.description: Default constructor for process information.

methods.name: ProcessInfo(const process_t& id)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize process info for a specific process ID.

methods.name: Priority()
methods.description: Retrieves the process priority.

methods.name: Priority(const int8_t priority)
methods.description: Sets the process priority.

methods.name: Policy()
methods.description: Retrieves the scheduling policy.

methods.name: Policy(const scheduler policy)
methods.description: Sets the scheduling policy.

methods.name: OOMAdjust()
methods.description: Gets the Out-Of-Memory adjustment value.

methods.name: OOMAdjust(const int8_t adjust)
methods.description: Sets the Out-Of-Memory adjustment value.

methods.name: IsActive()
methods.description: Checks if the process is active.

methods.name: Kill(const bool hardKill)
methods.description: Terminates the process, optionally forcefully.

methods.name: MemoryStats()
methods.description: Updates memory statistics for the process.

methods.name: USS()
methods.description: Returns the unique set size memory metric.

methods.name: PSS()
methods.description: Returns the proportional set size memory metric.

methods.name: RSS()
methods.description: Returns the resident set size memory metric.

methods.name: VSS()
methods.description: Returns the virtual set size memory metric.

methods.name: Allocated()
methods.description: Returns the total allocated memory for the process.

methods.name: Resident()
methods.description: Returns the resident memory size.

methods.name: Shared()
methods.description: Returns the shared memory size.

methods.name: Name()
methods.description: Retrieves the process name.

methods.name: Name(const string& name)
methods.description: Sets the process name.

methods.name: Executable()
methods.description: Retrieves the executable path.

methods.name: CommandLine()
methods.description: Retrieves the command line arguments.

methods.name: FindByName(const string& name, const bool exact, std::list<ProcessInfo>& processInfos)
methods.description: Finds processes by name.

methods.name: Dump()
methods.description: Sends a signal to generate a core dump for the process.

methods.name: User()
methods.description: Retrieves the user owning the process.

methods.name: User(const string& userName)
methods.description: Sets the user ownership of the process.

methods.name: Group()
methods.description: Retrieves the group owning the process.

methods.name: Group(const string& groupName)
methods.description: Sets the group ownership of the process.

methods.name: ContainsProcess(ThreadId pid)
methods.description: Checks if a process ID is within the process tree.

methods.name: GetProcessIds(std::list<ThreadId>& processIds)
methods.description: Retrieves all process IDs in the process tree.

methods.name: RootId()
methods.description: Returns the root process ID of the process tree.
